BACKPORT: media: staging/intel-ipu3: parameter buffer refactoring Current ImgU driver processes and releases the parameter buffer immediately after queued from user. This does not align with other image buffers which are grouped in sets and used for the same frame. If user queues multiple parameter buffers continuously, only the last one will take effect. To make consistent buffers usage, this patch changes the parameter buffer handling and group parameter buffer with other image buffers for each frame. Each time driver will queue one more group of buffers when previous frame processed and buffers consumed by css. FROMLIST: ALSA: core: Fix card races between register and disconnect commit 2a3f7221acddfe1caa9ff09b3a8158c39b2fdeac upstream. There is a small race window in the card disconnection code that allows the registration of another card with the very same card id. This leads to a warning in procfs creation as caught by syzkaller. The problem is that we delete snd_cards and snd_cards_lock entries at the very beginning of the disconnection procedure. This makes the slot available to be assigned for another card object while the disconnection procedure is being processed. Then it becomes possible to issue a procfs registration with the existing file name although we check the conflict beforehand. The fix is simply to move the snd_cards and snd_cards_lock clearances at the end of the disconnection procedure. The references to these entries are merely either from the global proc files like /proc/asound/cards or from the card registration / disconnection, so it should be fine to shift at the very end. amdgpu, i915, mediatek, msm, rockchip: Support I420 allocation for HW encoder HW encoder (VideoEncodeAccelerator, VEA) on Chromium can be fed NV12 buffer. VEA needs to specify a width/height of input buffer to be allocated. The fed input buffer needs to be copied if either its width or height is different from the specified width and height. Camera stack will create the source buffer by using GBM API. VEA should specify the width/height that matches minigbm implementation so as to avoid the redundant copy. VEA using VA-API knows the aligned width and height by actually allocating a buffer with GBM API. VEA can be fed I420 buffer too. VEA attempts to allocate I420 buffer. However, the current GBM doesn't support I420 buffer allocation. VaapiVEA could not knwo the aligned width and height.
